text: This guide lists important changes for immigrants in Germany in 2027.

title: Income tax
text: On January 1 2027, income tax is adjusted for inflation. If your salary stayed the same, you will pay a bit less income tax. Income tax calculator

title: Public health insurance
text: On January 1 2027, your public health insurance and long-term care insurance might get more expensive: If you earn more than € 76,500 per year Your health insurance gets more expensive. It still costs 7.3% of your salary, but the maximum cost increases from € 471 to € 512 per month. Your long-term care insurance gets more expensive. The maximum cost increases from € 140 to € 172 per month. Your health insurance gets more expensive. It still costs 7.3% of your salary, but the maximum cost increases from € 471 to € 512 per month. Your long-term care insurance gets more expensive. The maximum cost increases from € 140 to € 172 per month. If you are a student On April 1, the cost of your health insurance and long-term care insurance will increase from € 140 to € 155 per month. If you are over 23 years old, and you have no children Your long-term care insurance gets more expensive. It increases from 2.4% to 2.7% of your salary. Your long-term care insurance gets more expensive. It increases from 2.4% to 2.7% of your salary. Your insurer might also increase your Zusatzbeitrag. This will make your health insurance more expensive. You can switch to another public health insurer, or switch to private health insurance. Health insurance calculator

title: Private health insurance
text: From January 1 2027, employees must earn at least € 84,150 per year to choose private health insurance. In 2026, it was € 77,400 per year. If your salary is less than € 84,150 per year, you must switch to public health insurance. To stay on private health insurance, you must ask for an exemption. If you are self-employed, this change does not affect you.

title: Public pension insurance
text: On January 1 2027, the maximum cost of public pension insurance will increase to € 823 per month. In 2026, it was € 786 per month. It still costs 9.3% of your salary, but the contribution limit was raised. If you earn less than € 101,400 per year, this change does not affect you. If you are self-employed, you probably don’t pay public pension insurance, so this change does not affect you.

title: Unemployment insurance
text: On January 1 2027, the maximum cost of unemployment insurance increases to € 115 per month. In 2026, it was € 110 per month. It still costs 1.3% of your salary, but the contribution limit changes. If you earn less than € 101,400 per year, this change does not affect you. If you are self-employed, you probably don’t pay unemployment insurance, so this change does not affect you.

title: Minimum wage
text: On January 1 2027, the minimum wage increases to € 14.60 per hour. In 2026, it was € 13.90 per hour.

title: Minijobs
text: On January 1 2027, the maximum minijob income increases to € 633 per month. In 2026, it was € 603 per month.

title: More free mammograms
text: Women over 50 can get free mammogram screenings for breast cancer. Public health insurance pays for it. In August 2027, the minimum age will be lowered to 45 years old.

title: No free homeopathic medicine
text: On January 1 2027, public health insurance will stop covering homeopathic medicine.

title: Tobacco tax
text: The tobacco tax will increase on January 1 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030. Cigarettes will probably be more expensive.
